children: USANA Health Sciences entered into a First Amendment to its Credit Agreement, maintaining a $75 million revolving credit facility expandable to $200 million and maturing June 27, 2030. The amendment adds a minimum trailing four-quarter EBITDA covenant of $100 million, or $70 million if revolving exposure is $50 million or less at period-end. It also increases the general asset sale basket to $2.5 million, permits the sale of certain Sydney, Australia real property, and narrows restrictions on sale-leasebacks tied to that property. Management expects the changes to enhance liquidity and operating flexibility.
: Amendment to revolving credit facility (expandable to $200 million)
: Bank of America, as Administrative Agent, and other lenders
: Enhance liquidity and adjust covenants for flexibility
